policy.scope: Pure VOM and transaction/ref state-machine algorithms are copied and adapted to the local bridge.
policy.local_implementation: Local compiled behavior is implemented under packages/vom and apps/extension/src/background/*.
policy.adaptation: Relative imports and package targets were adapted for the local ESM/Vite/tsc toolchain. Ref ownership, CDP input, upload validation, effect classification, and structured failure codes are local additions.
policy.prohibited: Credentials, browser profiles, cookies, transport, daemon, Native Messaging, Named Pipe, MCP, branding, and publish machinery were not copied.
policy.publish_boundary: Local identity, credential, Native Messaging, Named Pipe, MCP, and publish boundaries remain governed by Kv Browser Bridge rules.
